turtle_01.title: Turtle's First Line
turtle_01.prompt: Make the little turtle walk 100 steps forward. Use the forward(number) function to draw your first straight line on the screen!
turtle_01.explanation: The `forward(100)` command makes the turtle walk 100 steps forward and draw a straight line!

turtle_02.title: Turning the Corner
turtle_02.prompt: Make the turtle walk 100 steps forward (forward(100)) and then turn 90 degrees to the right (right(90))!
turtle_02.explanation: We use `right(90)` to turn the turtle 90 degrees to the right. It is the perfect turn to make a corner!

turtle_03.title: Drawing a Square
turtle_03.prompt: Use a `for` loop to make the turtle turn 90 degrees 4 times and draw a perfect square!
turtle_03.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 turns of 90 degrees! With the `for i in range(4)` loop, the code is super clean.

turtle_04.title: The Magic Triangle
turtle_04.prompt: Draw a triangle with 3 equal sides! In a triangle, the turtle needs to turn 120 degrees at each corner.
turtle_04.explanation: To close a triangle, the turtle makes 3 turns of 120 degrees (3 x 120 = 360 degrees in total)!

turtle_05.title: The Shiny Star
turtle_05.prompt: Create a shiny 5-pointed star! Repeat 5 times: walk 100 steps forward (forward(100)) and turn 144 degrees to the right (right(144)).
turtle_05.explanation: With 144 degree turns, the lines cross perfectly to form a beautiful 5-pointed star! 🌟

turtle_06.title: The Honeycomb Hexagon
turtle_06.prompt: Create a 6-sided hexagon! Repeat 6 times: walk 80 steps and turn 60 degrees to the left.
turtle_06.explanation: A hexagon has 6 sides and 60 degree turns! It is the shape used by bees to build honeycombs! 🐝

boss_battle_16.title: The Master of Brushes
boss_battle_16.prompt: Import `turtle`, create `t = turtle.Turtle()` and use a loop `for i in range(3): t.forward(50); t.left(120)` to draw a triangle!
boss_battle_16.explanation: The Master of Brushes wants to see you draw a perfect triangle with 3 turns of 120 degrees!
